stem.text: A pipe of length $L$ is open at one end and closed at the other end. A loudspeaker is at the open end and emits a sound wave into the pipe.

stem.alt: Pipe drawn to the right of a loudspeaker, with a horizontal double arrow labelled L along the pipe length; labels pipe and loudspeaker.

stem.text: When a stationary wave is formed, there is an antinode at the open end of the pipe.
Which wavelength of sound could be used to produce a stationary wave?
